# THE COMPONENT LICENCE REGISTER: one row per third-party software component
# the stack fetches, bundles or runs, beside images/models/licence-register.tsv
# (media models). TAB-separated, no interpreter. Grammar from the licence
# management design (plan/issues/third-party-licence-management-2026-10-31.md
# D1, PR #781); this file starts with the web-studio lanes, the first
# components approved under that rule, and the stack ledger (the "Powered By"
# graph) reads its rows.
# Columns:
#   component     package or project name
#   version       exact version pinned
#   source        where it is fetched from (registry, tarball URL)
#   kind          base-image | distro-packages | npm | pip | binary | git-build | model | cli
#   licence_id    SPDX id (LicenseRef-<name> for anything else)
#   licence_url   where the licence text was read
#   licence_sha256  sha256 of the licence text shown to a user; - when none is shown
#   distribution  fetched (installed and run in an image) | bundled (compiled
#                 into a shipped file) | build-only (used in a discarded build
#                 stage; NOT in any final image) | redistributed
#   tier          acknowledge | accept | refuse
#   reaccept_on   text | version | never
#   image         the image (images/<dir>) the component belongs to
#   verified      ISO date and who approved it
